# Check A04-10: Space after an English word

1. Choose Tatakikun as the input source in TextEdit (or any app).
2. Type `hello`, press Space, type `world`, press Space. Expect `hello world ` (one half-width space after each word).
3. Type `nihao`, press Space. Expect `你好` with no space after it.
4. Type `konnichiha`, move to the hiragana candidate with →, press Space. Expect `こんにちは` with no space after it.
5. Type `hello`, press 1 (or Return). Expect `hello` with no space after it (only Space adds the space).
6. iOS (optional): in the Tatakikun app's demo screen, type `hello` and tap space; expect `hello `.
